raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 동네 생활수리 워크숍을 홍보해줘. SNS와 지역 커뮤니티에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 다섯 장은 전체 스타일과 구도가 서로 달랐으면 좋겠어. 의자나 옷을 함께 고치는 경험이 시각적으로 느껴져야 하고, 설명부터 일정·장소·비용·신청 안내까지 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 본문을 작게 구석에 밀어 넣지 말아줘. 단색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목·정보 블록에 작은 그림만 붙인 구성, 빈 방을 글자판으로 쓴 구성은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 아래 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

고쳐 쓰는 토요일

헐거워진 의자와 찢어진 옷을 가져오세요. 이웃 수리자와 도구를 나누며 다시 쓰는 방법을 배웁니다.

The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts. I actually displayed each exact poster file through tools.view_image with detail original, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All fifteen displays were complete before the first poster copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. After that complete pass I retained all twelve actual first readings for each image in packet copy order. For dash-class ambiguity I actually reopened each member's same pinned native view once, in M1–M5 order; the M5 opening also inspected its deadline word spaces. Thus there were fifteen initial poster displays and five ambiguity revisit displays. Copy arrays preserve the first readings and exact revisit bindings, including the unresolved M3 stroke class. Ratings and set diversity were judged from the pixels after the complete viewing pass. Successful helper exits, hashes and filenames were not treated as semantic viewing. No source opens were needed or claimed, no peer/producer/planner records were read, no images were edited or created, and no runtime session identity or serialized opening event was invented.

procedure.method: In this fresh independent session I read the pinned packet/case, rules, rubric, ratio policy and compact recording instructions, verified declared input hashes/bytes, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets or protected-layout manifests, so there were no source opens or protected-layout reads. I actually opened and visually inspected the exact pinned poster PNGs using tools.view_image, forwarding each returned image through functions.exec with original detail, in this order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All fifteen initial views were complete before the first deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or any score. Native views were 1672×941; use views 720×405; thumbnails 320×180. No images were produced, edited, cropped or substituted. No unlisted paths, peer reviews, maker self-inspections or planner narratives were read, and no agents were spawned, resumed or forked.
